name: Hornero Pomodoro
description: Pomodoro: a bar focus timer with short and long breaks, deadline-correct timing across sleep and reload, and an optional hook that switches the shell to the Focus experience while you focus and puts your mode back afterwards.
author: HorneroOS contributors

longBreakMinutes.description: Long break length in minutes, after a full set of focus sessions.

cyclesBeforeLongBreak.description: Focus sessions in a set before the long break.

autoStartNext.description: Start the next phase by itself instead of waiting for you.

experienceHook.description: Focus: switch the shell to the Focus experience during focus phases and restore your mode after. Needs horneroctl.

deadlineEpochMs.description: Saved running deadline in epoch milliseconds (0 when not running). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

remainingSeconds.description: Saved paused time remaining in seconds (0 means a full session). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

phase.description: Saved current phase. Managed by the timer; do not edit.

setCount.description: Saved focus sessions finished in this set. Managed by the timer; do not edit.

changelog.notes: Break cycle (short and long breaks, configurable set size, optional auto-start), Skip, a display readout with set meter, and an optional Experience hook that switches to Focus during focus phases and restores your previous mode. Stored session state is unchanged; the hook is off by default.
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: Hornero Glyph indicator (hourglass/bell) in place of Material names, no icon fill axis.
Popover: session length in whole minutes (was 25.00).
Suppress the indicator tooltip while its popover is open (it floated over the popover).

Native popout: subtitle header, caption state line and label/value detail rows (PluginKit UiDetailRow); session actions without floating tooltips. Needs Hornero Shell 1.2.74 (UiText subtitle, UiDetailRow, borderless UiPopover).
Native look: timer icon plus time in the bar (filled while running), alarm icon when finished. Needs Hornero Shell 1.2.72 (PluginKit UiIcon/iconName/card header).

Productivity Timers 2.0: compact indicator plus popover controls, deadline-correct timing persisted across sleep/reload, typed focusMinutes setting (default 25), completion toast, Theme tokens and Argentine Spanish translation.
Bar focus timer: click to start or pause, flashing DONE at zero, then reset.
